description: The Pages section at the top of Record's left column: the open notebook's pages as an indented tree (a sub-page on its own line under its parent), above the notebooks.

parts.name: Pages header
parts.shows: A group header: an arrow, "Pages", and a + button on the right with the tooltip "New page (+Name in a page makes one under it)". The arrow folds the list away (kept); the notebooks section then takes the spare height.
text: New page (+Name in a page makes one under it)

actions.by: click the arrow or the header
actions.does: Folds or unfolds the pages list.
New page dialog (RecordAlerts), the page made at the top level.

parts.name: page row
parts.shows: One line per page, indented by depth (a page called Work:Plans shows as Plans under Work, with a tree line from its parent's name; hovering a sub-page shows its full name). Home is first, then the rest sorted by name, case-insensitively, each parent before its children. The page in the tab shown is selected. What is listed: pages with something written in them, every page a [[link]] anywhere goes to, Home, the pages open, and their parents. A page with nothing written yet is grey and italic. A page whose title is being typed in shows the typed name at once. Names too long fade out. Pages Meta added are marked green; deleted ones stay listed, struck through, until kept or undone; moved and highlighted ones are marked too. An open page's title takes its row's mark (RecordNotes).

actions.does: Opens the page in a tab (shown if already open). A page Meta deleted (not yet kept or undone) opens read-only as it was, all of it struck through on red (RecordNotes, page deleted by Meta).

decisions.said: A page's name in the left bar should change live as it's renamed in the top bar (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows a page's typed title in its pages-list row and its tab at once, a keystroke at a time; the row is re-sorted only once the name is kept, and Escape puts the old name back

states.name: empty page left
states.shows: A page with nothing written that nothing links to and that is not open and not Home goes from the list (and from the notebook) when its tab closes.
